chunks: Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from some of his companions, from Abu al-Hasan al-Rida عليه السلام, that he went out from al-Madinah in

the year in which Harun performed hajj, intending the hajj. He came to a mountain on the left of the road as you are going to Makkah, called Fari'. Abu al-Hasan looked at it, then said: 'The builder of Fari' and its demolisher will be cut limb by limb.'

So we did not know what that meant. Then, when he had departed, Harun arrived and camped at that place. Ja'far ibn Yahya climbed that mountain and ordered that a sitting place be built there for him. Then when he returned from Makkah, he climbed it and ordered it to be demolished. Then when he departed to al-'Iraq, he was cut limb by limb.

key_terms.إِرْبًا: a piece or limb, used here in the expression for being cut into pieces
key_terms.السَّنَةِ: the specific year in which the reported event took place
key_terms.الْحَجَّ: the pilgrimage to Makkah intended in the narration
key_terms.بَانِي: the one who would build on the mountain
key_terms.جَبَلٍ: the mountain encountered on the route to Makkah
key_terms.فَارِعٌ: the name of the mountain mentioned in the report
key_terms.هَادِمُهُ: the one who would demolish what was built there
key_terms.هَارُونُ: Harun, the ruler whose hajj journey frames the event

ai.seo_question: What did Imam al-Rida عليه السلام foretell about the mountain called Fari' during the hajj journey?
ai.summary: This narration relates an event during the journey for hajj in which Imam al-Rida عليه السلام pointed to a mountain called Fari' and foretold the fate of the one who would build upon it and then destroy it. The later occurrence fulfilled those words when Ja'far ibn Yahya built a structure there, then demolished it, and was afterward cut into pieces.
